claim: For all integers \(m,n\ge1\), let \(R_{m,n}=K_m\square K_n\) be the rectangular rook graph and let \(I_{m,n}(z)=\sum_M z^{|M|}\) sum over its induced matchings. Then \[I_{m,n}(z)=\sum_{\substack{h,v\ge0\\h+2v\le m\\2h+v\le n}} \frac{m!\,n!}{h!\,v!\,2^{h+v}(m-h-2v)!(n-v-2h)!}z^{h+v},\] and consequently \(\nu_s(R_{m,n})=\min\{m,n,\lfloor(m+n)/3\rfloor\}\).

title: The induced-matching polynomial of rectangular rook graphs
